Overlapping Picture

Find the picture missing from the overlap

How to Play

Memorize: seven numbered pictures appear together. Study them before the timer runs out.

Look: six of them come back stacked into one overlapping image — exactly one is left out.

Answer: tap the number of the picture that is missing from the stack, then submit. The stack drops apart into the numbered slots to show you the answer.

Modes: Competition scores nine set rounds, Practice replays any single round unscored, and Challenge builds fresh rounds from a code you can share.
